utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you help me sort the tools and see what still needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the tools and make a quick list of what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that—what’s the repair drive needing most right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the details first so I don’t miss anything—what’s the repair drive short on most right now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No rush—just let me know if you need tools, extra hands, or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d really help. I’ve been a bit all over the place lately, so I might miss something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll keep track and let you know right away if we’re running low on anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you need a hand, I can help check what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be really helpful, thanks. I’m a little worried I’ll miss something or schedule things wrong, so a quick check would be great.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I can help sort through it with you and make sure the list and timing look right.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and stay on standby for supply sorting if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted once I hear the next update on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good, Nell—just let me know what you need and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout—folks are dropping off tools and supplies already. If you’re heading over, I’d go early before the best stuff gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll head over early and see what I can lend a hand with.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Gus — they could really use an extra pair of hands. If you spot any need for hammers, tape, or tarps, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please save me a spot. Where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re meeting at the community center on Maple, around 6 PM. I’ll save you a spot!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm you’re actually available this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m available this Saturday and can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and warm, just like the block needs. What should we prioritize first, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the biggest fixes first, then anything urgent folks need today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — I’ll put the biggest fixes at the top and flag anything urgent for today. If you know the rough list, I can start sorting it now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the repair drive plan to folks nearby and make sure everyone knows the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. I’ll keep to the plan and let folks know if they ask.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask if you still need help carrying anything over. I can stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I could use a hand carrying a few things over, if you’ve got a moment.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ve got a moment, and I’ll come over now to help carry them over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together — want to tell me what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just a few last drop-offs and checking who still needs parts. I can swing by the hardware store and see what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in — I’ll spread the word and help get people over there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, thanks Quinn — I’ll swing by a little late but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll make sure folks know you’re coming. See you there, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly a clear plan and a few steady hands. If you can help sort the tools and make a list, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll help sort the tools and make a list so we’ve got a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — that would help a lot. Keep it quiet, and if you find anything else useful, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I find anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll stay close to the school schedule and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help spread the word and connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need me to tell people?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tell folks we’re meeting by the community shed this Saturday afternoon for the repair drive, and to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll tell everyone to meet by the community shed this Saturday afternoon and bring any spare tools they can share.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll swing by with my toolbox soon — just let me know what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive location posted yet—if you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, thanks for catching that, Opal — I’ll post the location right away and keep you in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — once it’s posted, I’ll make a note of the location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are you still collecting donations for the repair drive? If so, what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I’m still collecting donations. Right now we need cash donations most, but tools and good-condition supplies are helpful too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help with cash. Is there a drop-off spot nearby?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help me keep track of donated supplies and make a quick list of what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can keep track of the donated supplies and note what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s soon? I haven’t really been following it, but I’m pretty sure someone’s organizing things.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for more details from the folks organizing it. If you hear anything, let me know!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening! I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Just let me know if the time or place changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm in, Leo. Just remind me what I signed up to bring, and I’ll make sure it gets there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: You said you’d bring the tape and a couple of screwdrivers. If you can’t find them, I’ve got backups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s right—tape and a couple of screwdrivers. I’ll check my junk drawer and bring them over if I can find them.
